title: HEART: Emotionally-Driven Test-Time Scaling of Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on test-time scaling for LLMs by using emotional prompts to improve reasoning performance. Although it evaluates these methods using 'Humanity’s Last Exam' (HLE), which covers various academic fields including the humanities, the core contribution and analysis of the paper are centered on logical reasoning, coding, and mathematical benchmarks rather than a specific evaluation of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
